mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3%, the real interest rate is deeply negative, signaling a highly accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE is above 8% and PAYEMS shows negative growth for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS negative growth for 2 months
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS shows negative growth for 2 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 shows negative growth for two consecutive quarters and INDPRO is also declining, it signals a broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative growth for 2 quarters and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows negative growth for 2 quarters and INDPRO is declining and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
